maria: Quick workshop request  Need very short hero + 1-line subhead variants for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Also one tidy benchmark teaser for social (no raw numbers), and a clear inbound routing map for the webinar landing form. Goal: copy ready for handoff by tomorrow noon.

tom: Tone rec: Hosted = energetic PLG, Dedicated = pragmatic product + cost, Private = authoritative enterprise. Keep CTAs 31 chars max where possible.

jess: Drafts (hero  subhead  CTA)
- Hosted: "Start with Redwood Hosted"  "Prototype fast, scale seamlessly."  "Start free"
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity"  "Predictable throughput for production."  "Reserve capacity"
- Private: "Private deployment options"  "VPC, KMS, and on-prem choices for compliance."  "Contact sales"

maria: These are great, shorter Hosted subhead: "Fast time-to-value." Replace Hosted CTA with "Try Hosted". Little tweak to Private CTA -> "Request a private demo".

li: Webinar landing routing rules (HubSpot form mapping):
```
if form.submission == "hosted_trial": assign.lifecycle = "MQL"; add.utm = "launch_webinar";
if form.submission == "dedicated_interest": assign.owner = "AE_pool"; add.tag = "dedicated"
if form.submission == "private_contact": assign.owner = "Enterprise_SDR"; notify.team = "sales-enterprise"
```
I'll push these as workflows and add hidden fields for `utm_campaign=launch_webinar`.

opsbot: calendar: Webinar: "Runbook + Benchmarks" on 2025-05-14 15:00 UTC. Invite sent to speakers @maria @jess @li :calendar:

tom: Benchmark teaser (social-safe): "Watch our webinar for independent latency & cost comparisons and a live walkthrough of Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments." Short alt: "Benchmarks & demo  5/14 Sign up." 

maria: Perfect. Jess make final copy variations (3x each) and throw them in the doc. Li confirm workflow push and post the workflow IDs. Thanks team :rocket:
